COMPULSORY_MEMBERS.rule: All named compulsory members must belong to the selected set.

EXCLUDED_MEMBERS.rule: All named excluded members must remain outside the selected set.

COMPULSORY_AND_EXCLUDED.rule: The compulsory member is selected and the excluded member is not selected.

EXACT_TWO_CATEGORY_QUOTA.rule: The selected set contains exactly the required count from Category A and the balance from Category B.

AT_LEAST_TWO_CATEGORY_QUOTA.rule: The selected set contains at least the stated count from Category A.

AT_MOST_TWO_CATEGORY_QUOTA.rule: The selected set contains at most the stated count from Category A.

AT_LEAST_ONE_CATEGORY.rule: At least one selected member belongs to Category A.

AT_LEAST_ONE_EACH_TWO_CATEGORIES.rule: At least one selected member belongs to each of two categories.

EXACT_THREE_CATEGORY_DISTRIBUTION.rule: The selected set follows the stated exact distribution across three categories.

AT_LEAST_ONE_EACH_THREE_CATEGORIES.rule: At least one selected member belongs to each of three categories.

EXACT_SPECIFIED_MEMBERS.rule: Exactly the stated number of specially identified members are selected.

AT_LEAST_ONE_SPECIFIED_MEMBER.rule: At least one specially identified member is selected.

NOT_ALL_SPECIFIED_TOGETHER.rule: The specially identified members may not all be selected together.

ALL_OR_NONE_SPECIFIED.rule: Either every specially identified member is selected or none is selected.

MEMBER_IMPLICATION.rule: Selecting B requires selecting A; committees containing B without A are invalid.

AT_MOST_SPECIFIED_MEMBERS.rule: At most the stated number of specially identified members are selected.

NAMED_COMPULSORY_CATEGORY_QUOTA.rule: A named Category-A member is compulsory and the final Category-A quota is exact.

NAMED_EXCLUDED_CATEGORY_QUOTA.rule: A named Category-A member is unavailable and the final Category-A quota is exact.

CONDITIONAL_SELECTION_INVERSE.rule: A bounded integer parameter is recovered from an exact conditional-selection count.
